purpose: Extend the spritesheet sidecar proof to packed trim/rotation atlas frames and a deterministic looped runtime playback model.

external_anchors.used_for: Packed spritesheet workflow and frame metadata boundary.
Packed sheet type, trimming, sheet size, and JSON data export context.
PNG remains the visual carrier for packed atlas spritesheets.

limitations: Stage 0 packed runtime decoder supports sidecar-described trim and 90-degree rotation only.
Runtime playback is a deterministic metadata playback model, not a production renderer.
Semantic grid metadata is restored from the sidecar; PNG pixels remain a visual carrier.

runtime_playback.sampling_rule: time_ms modulo total_duration_ms selects first cumulative frame interval
